idea: Signal yellow on a void with a violet cast: yellow acts and grounds, blood red alarms, cyan labels what must be read. Every corner is square or cut by a notch, the type is uppercase and spaced, and machine prefixes (///, >, !!) speak for the interface. Motion is a signal being acquired: text deciphers out of noise, a slice burst fires once, a charge sweeps across a button.

loadBearing.claim: Yellow acts and grounds, red alarms, cyan labels: swap any two and it is a different theme.
The app ink is a warm smoke on a violet-cast void, never white on black.
The radius is 0: every corner is square or a notch cut off it.
Headings, buttons, links and labels are uppercase and letter-spaced; labels and identifiers speak in the mono face.
Motion glitches once and settles: decipher, slice burst, charge sweep. The only loop is the data stream between sections.

colourRoles.use: The primary action's fill, the navbar and hero ground, the section heading's brackets, the selected tab's underline, the focus ring.
colourRoles.never: Body text in long runs, or a large ground inside the app surface; it is the one colour that is both a surface and a signal, so it is spent on those two jobs only.

colourRoles.use: The app ground, the face of every unfilled button, the dropdown panel, the strip behind the nav links.
colourRoles.never: Pure black; the void keeps its violet cast.

colourRoles.use: Running text and ghost button labels on the void.
colourRoles.never: White: white on the void reads as a terminal, smoke reads as print.

colourRoles.use: What must be read: microlabels, field labels, table headers, the drawn rule, the caret, the tooltip frame, a toast's left edge, the charge band on a dark face.
colourRoles.never: A ground or a button fill.

colourRoles.use: The destructive plate, an invalid field's border, the error summary's edge, the alarm's ink, the band's letters on yellow.
colourRoles.never: Decoration or a hover colour: red only ever means something is wrong.

colourRoles.use: The alert plate and the second ink on the hero, where the brighter red would not read.
colourRoles.never: On the void, where the brighter destructive red is the alarm.

colourRoles.use: The edge of a control that must be found (DI1), the disabled button's frame, the side navigation's edge, a picture's frame.
colourRoles.never: A decorative hairline; that is the hairline below.

colourRoles.use: The primary at 22 %: the frame of a card, a panel, a tag, a fieldset, the gaps of a grid.
colourRoles.never: A control boundary; it sits under 3:1 on purpose.

colourRoles.use: The second copy of the headline's slice burst, and charts.
colourRoles.never: Anywhere outside a glitch slice or a chart.

type.tracking: 0.005em on a surface headline, 0.01em on headings
type.weight: 900 headline, 800 section heading and card title
type.description: Big Shoulders Display, condensed and heavy: the headline fills the hero, a section heading wears the bracket frame.
Rajdhani: squared-off, technical, still readable at length.
KP Tech Mono (Share Tech Mono) for microlabels, field labels, badges, tabs, toasts, identifiers and timestamps: the interface talking.
Actions are spaced capitals in the body face, never the mono.

radius.description: 0 everywhere: the token is 0 and the register restates border-radius: 0 on badges, cards, panels, tabs and pickers.

borders.description: A button has no border: its frame is the background colour, the face is inset 2px and a 10px slit runs through the middle. Cards and panels take a 1px hairline; toasts and alerts a 3px left edge.

shadows.description: None. Buttons and cards set box-shadow: none; the focus ring is an inset box-shadow drawn on the face, inside the clip.

signature.description: The notch. A button's bottom-right corner is cut by 14px, an input, badge, toast and alert by 8px; a card cuts its top-right by 16px; a dialog and the spec sheet cut two opposite corners by 18px; a button pointing back carries the notch bottom-left.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.description: Signal yellow with ink on it. The primary button inverts to ink with yellow letters, the card is the deeper yellow, the alert the deeper red with white letters.

surfaces.name: app
surfaces.description: The void, with smoke on it. Cards rise to 8 % and popovers to 10 % lightness; the scanlines and a faint vignette lie over the whole page.

surfaces.name: footer
surfaces.description: Near-black under the page, headings in mono capitals in the signal, links spaced capitals that turn yellow under the pointer.

flicker.reason: Glitch is this theme's own vocabulary: the headline's slice burst and the nav link's hover slice already step between frames, each with its rate in reports/di5.md.

enter.description: A panel drops into place: the nav dropdown rises 6px into position as it fades in, and the strip of links slides in 24px from its own side once, on load.
enter.duration: 180ms (--fx-duration) for the dropdown; 520ms after 80ms for the strip
enter.reducedMotion: The dropdown appears in place and the strip stands at rest.
enter.note: Dialogs, popovers and toasts have no entrance of their own; see the recipe.

leave.description: Classified words are released: the ink bar over each marked phrase wipes off toward its right edge, one phrase after another, and the words turn the link colour and bold.
leave.reducedMotion: The phrases stand cleared at once, in the link colour and bold.
leave.note: No component leaves with motion: a dialog, toast or dropdown is simply gone. See the recipe.

press.description: The button drops by --fx-lift (1px) and its fill steps to the pressed token.
press.reducedMotion: The drop and the pressed fill still happen, at once.

hover.description: The button lifts 1px and a charge band sweeps across its face once: cyan over a dark face, the face's own ink over a filled one. A nav link fires a two-step slice.
hover.reducedMotion: The lift and the hover fill remain, at once; no sweep, no slice.

load.description: The headline deciphers left to right out of glyph noise, then one slice burst in cyan and violet; a section rule draws in from the left when its heading scrolls into view.
load.duration: 26 characters per second, then 600ms of slices; 900ms rule
load.easing: steps(1, end) for the slices; --fx-ease for the rule
load.reducedMotion: The headline stands as its own text and the rule stands drawn.

attention.description: The alarm: blood red on the void with the signal-yellow split and hazard bars, striking on like a failing tube (a catch at 60%, a sag with a sideways kick, full), then the package's decode, slice and marching bars in this theme's colours. Smaller asks keep to the edge: a 3px left edge on a toast or an alert, '!! ' before an error.
attention.easing: steps(1, end) flicker; ease-in-out glow; linear march
attention.reducedMotion: The plate, frame, bars and glow at full strength; nothing moves.
attention.note: scope-96 stopped this theme's own alarm redesign until the portraits are approved; what plays here is the alarm as it ships.

ornaments.name: The data stream
ornaments.where: Between two surfaces: [data-kp-divider], the alt one before the footer.
ornaments.description: Three rows of muted yellow dashes and a few cyan packets under a scan hairline, drifting at two speeds; the alt divider flows the other way.

ornaments.name: The bracket frame
ornaments.where: A section heading on a surface.
ornaments.description: Two yellow corner brackets over the heading, drawn as four gradients so both pseudo-elements stay free.

ornaments.name: The notch and the slit
ornaments.where: Buttons, inputs, badges, toasts, alerts, cards, dialogs, the current side navigation row.
ornaments.description: A cut corner instead of a radius, and on a button a slit through the frame.

ornaments.name: Machine prefixes
ornaments.where: Microlabels, field labels, errors, breadcrumbs, menu items.
ornaments.description: '/// ' before a microlabel, '> ' before a label, '!! ' before an error, '//' between breadcrumb steps, '— ' before a menu item.

ornaments.name: The file stamp
ornaments.where: A card that carries an emphasis reveal and a label.
ornaments.description: The consumer's label in spaced mono, in a red frame rotated -4deg, over a dossier whose redactions lift.

ornaments.name: The band
ornaments.description: Signal yellow with blood-red mono capitals and every corner cut the same; red on yellow reads 3.21, approved by Kenny on 2026-09-08.

ornaments.name: Scanlines and vignette
ornaments.where: The page's texture layer, over everything.
ornaments.description: Static yellow scanlines every 3px and a faint vignette, both at the texture ceiling's 6 %.

voice.case: UPPERCASE for headings, buttons, nav links, labels, badges, tabs and the breadcrumb; running text as written.
labels: A field label starts with '> ' and is mono cyan.
Breadcrumb steps are joined by '//'; menu items start with '— '.
A stamp carries the consumer's own label (js/strings.js), never a word written in CSS.
voice.icons: Drawn geometry instead of icons: a health dot is a square turned 45deg, a dropdown link carries a CSS caret, the checkbox tick is a notched block.
neverDoes: Pure black, or white text on the void.
A rounded corner or a soft shadow.
A second loop besides the data stream and the marquee.

recipe.answer: The alarm: red on the void, yellow split and hazard bars, flicker and decode allowed.
A notched plate in mono with a 3px left edge in its own ink; words in the status colour carry the meaning.
The notched, slit button: yellow fill for the one primary action, void face with a yellow frame for the rest; lift and charge on hover, drop on press.
A 12 % wash of the signal behind a nav or menu row; a one-shot slice on a nav link; a charge sweep on a button.
The dropdown drops 6px into place over --fx-duration on --fx-ease, clipped with its cut corner.
No entrance today: the panel is there at once, already notched and framed.
recipe.proposal: Borrow the dropdown's drop (translate 0 -6px to 0 with the fade, --fx-duration, --fx-ease) and, for a toast only, one kp-slice-a burst on arrival; nothing under reduced motion.

recipe.answer: No exit today: the panel is simply gone. The theme's own way of taking something away is the redaction bar wiping off.
recipe.proposal: A clip wipe toward the notch (clip-path inset from 0 to 100 % on the right, --kp-wipe, --fx-ease), the mirror of the redaction clear; nothing under reduced motion.

recipe.answer: A square spinner in yellow and cyan and a skeleton sweeping card to secondary; the package's own spin and pulse drive them.
The data stream divider; before the footer, the alt one flowing the other way.
Mono capitals with a prefix; identifiers and timestamps in the mono face, timestamps muted.

banner.description: A banner that asks for attention, from existing parts only: an app surface with a microlabel, the destructive alert (notched, 3px left edge, the words 'Warning:' carrying the meaning), the primary and ghost buttons, and the data stream closing it off. Nothing here is new CSS.
